name: stacks
description: Scaffold new projects from battle-tested house templates. Subtractive templates (a runnable superset app minus the features you didn't pick) plus a zero-dependency generator CLI. Ships five stacks: a NestJS API (Prisma + Redis + BullMQ + better-auth + Vitest), a single-app React frontend, a Turborepo React monorepo, a standalone Node worker, and a Python worker. Two skills: /stack-new to scaffold, /stack-sync to fold improvements from a live codebase back into the template.
